definitions.explanation: Vegetables or other ingredients dressed with a seasoned sauce, typically served cold. A category of Japanese side dishes.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}の{和|あ}え{物|もの}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a vegetable dressed dish.

examples.japanese: {和|あ}え{物|もの}はおかずの{一|ひと}つです。
examples.english: A dressed dish is one type of side dish.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}{和|あ}えは{豆腐|とうふ}ベースの{和|あ}え{物|もの}です。
examples.english: Shira-ae is a tofu-based dressed dish.

examples.japanese: {和|あ}え{物|もの}は{食卓|しょくたく}に{彩|いろど}りを{加|くわ}えてくれる{一品|いっぴん}です。
examples.english: A dressed dish is a side that adds color to the dinner table.

examples.japanese: {旬|しゅん}の{野菜|やさい}を{使|つか}った{和|あ}え{物|もの}は、{季節|きせつ}の{味|あじ}を{楽|たの}しむことができます。
examples.english: Dressed dishes made with seasonal vegetables let you enjoy the flavors of the season.

notes:
{和|あ}え{物|もの} refers to dishes mixed with a dressing ({和|あ}える = to dress/mix).

Common types by dressing:
- {胡麻|ごま}{和|あ}え (sesame dressing)
- {白|しろ}{和|あ}え (tofu-based dressing)
- {酢味噌|すみそ}{和|あ}え (vinegar-miso dressing)
- {梅|うめ}{和|あ}え (plum dressing)
- からし{和|あ}え (mustard dressing)

Common ingredients:
- ほうれん{草|そう} (spinach)
- いんげん (green beans)
- {蒟蒻|こんにゃく} (konjac)
- {貝|かい}{類|るい} (shellfish)

Usually served as {副菜|ふくさい} (side dish) in a traditional meal.

Related:
- {酢|す}の{物|もの} (vinegared dishes) - similar category
